name.zh: 勇者之塔 第65层 海德拉、迷你果、刺爪蟹

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔

reward_note: No per-floor reward is recorded for 61-69.

capture.zh: 勇者之塔第65层：海德拉、迷你果、刺爪蟹，Lv270，每只约1350血。

strategy_notes.zh: 寄生后换光系干掉海德拉，弱化迷你果攻击，魔焰觉醒2次干掉，螃蟹顺手解决

engine_notes: Part of chain data/bosses/chains/tower_brave.json: floors are fought in order with no healing between floors; a lost battle sends the player back to floor 1 (restart_on_loss). Fleeing a floor did not reset progress (4399: 只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
Lv/HP from 聚侠 (61F Lv230 Hp1150 … 65F Lv270 Hp1350, i.e. +10 Lv per floor and HP = 5×Lv per monster); 66-70 are extrapolated on the same step.
heal_full_below {pct:20, member}: 61层以上的草系1/5血以下的时候会回满Hp (聚侠). Applies only to the grass-type member(s) listed by index; the engine's heal_full_below needs a per-member form.
Identification: team[2] 利爪蟹 is not a known species name; 刺爪蟹 (231) is a guess.
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔61-70层简单攻略 (2010-10-10) and 聚侠 61-70层攻略 (61-65 line-ups with Lv/HP).
